about: The one filter vocabulary for filter rows (docs/specs/goal-panel-and-ts-order.md section 3). ACP's migration (filter_rows.row_filter), the Python writer and importer (nina_ts_sync.rows.row_filter) and the plugin (TsRows.RowFilter) all read this table in their tests. Each case is a goal key or a TS filtername and the row filter it becomes. The alias table names a known filter; a name it does not know is tried on its first word; anything else stays as it is, trimmed.
